segments.vv75:1.3: Tathūpamaṃ tuyhamidaṃ vimānaṃ, obhāsayaṃ tiṭṭhati antalikkhe.
segments.vv75:2.3: Kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo, vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
segments.vv75:3.1: So devaputto attamano … pe … yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.vv75:4.1: “Ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūto, daliddo atāṇo kapaṇo kammakaro ahosiṃ;
segments.vv75:4.3: Jiṇṇe ca mātāpitaro abhāriṃ [abhariṃ (sī. syā.)], piyā ca me sīlavanto ahesuṃ;
segments.vv75:4.5: Annañca pānañca pasannacitto, sakkacca dānaṃ vipulaṃ adāsi.
segments.vv75:5.1: “Tena metādiso vaṇṇo … pe … vaṇṇo ca me sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
